lanes.title: A1–A4 — CandidateTicket acceptance, stable strip, reject feedback, gesture thresholds, haptics, diagnostics, ImeReplayInstrumentedTest harness
acceptance: Ticket captured at ACTION_DOWN; acceptance validates epochs/connection/no-selection/same-word-slot; intent-wins replaces the current word in-slot; requestGeneration/wordRevision/personalizationEpoch excluded; commit_pending_replacement runs after validation then re-validates only the current slot.

No silent tap failure: commit mismatch or INCOMPLETE triggers one bounded synchronous refresh (≤64 chars) + one retry; further failure or verification failure shows the 120 ms shake + reject haptic; every exit inserts or rejects visibly; rejections counted.

PENDING keeps prior READY items visible/tappable in the same session+connection+epochs+slot; slot change removes old-word items immediately; >150 ms pending dims to 70% alpha, restored on READY; EMPTY and real clears unchanged.
prepare_commit_for_ticket accepts a retained result matching the ticket's word fingerprint (recent-results ring ≤2); unmatched inserts with no learning token.

Gestures: tap <|32dp dx, <40dp dy or non-swipe; horizontal page |dx|≥32dp && |dx|≥1.5|dy|; vertical swipe |dy|≥40dp && |dy|≥2|dx|; ACTION_CANCEL no-op; 30 dp drift = tap (test); swipe-up learn applies to literal/WORD slots only.
Exactly once per ticket across onTouch+onClick and multi-finger; new ticket after 300 ms is a genuine action.
Accept haptic KEYBOARD_TAP via VibratorCompat honoring vibration setting + ti_strip_haptic_accept switch (default ON) under Smart typing → Suggestions with the spec'd summary.
Debug counters (accepted, rejected-mismatch, ignored-duplicate, pending-at-tap) logged every 50 events in debug builds; never persisted.
